title: docs(readme): reposition as the developer framework (vs the ObjectOS runtime)
body:
## What

`framework` (ObjectStack) is the **developer framework**; `../objectos` is the **end-user runtime**. The README had drifted into ObjectOS's territory (runtime dashboards, "AI operates it within RBAC/RLS/audit"). This repositions it around the framework/protocol story.

- **Hero** — dev/protocol tagline + an `ObjectStack → describe / ObjectOS → run` boundary box; leads with the metadata→surfaces architecture diagram instead of a runtime dashboard.
- **Author your app** — replaces "See it in action": a real `ObjectSchema` sample + Studio object/flow designers (authoring is the framework's surface). The runtime gallery moved to the ObjectOS README (objectstack-ai/objectos#31) with a "see it running" link.
- **Use the generated API** — REST example + SDK/plugin pointers for developers.
- **Dedupe** — runtime/governance claims now point to ObjectOS.
- Removes the 6 runtime screenshots (now hosted in objectos).

Pairs with objectstack-ai/objectos#31. Docs-only.
